shape: ONE mature East Asian Reishi (Ganoderma sichuanense, synonym G. lingzhi): a broad kidney/fan-shaped lacquer-red / deep reddish chestnut cap with a thin golden-yellow outer growing edge, pale ochre pore underside (NO radial gills), and one clearly visible short-to-medium DARK BROWN curved LATERAL stalk. Keep a very readable kidney-shaped cap with an indentation by the side attachment, not a symmetrical button cap. In the scientific figure use ONLY macroscopic panels A/B at the TOP, not microscopic panels, slices, text or scale bars.
variation: A wider kidney-shaped red-brown cap tilted slightly right, a thinner yellow rim and a distinctly curved lateral dark brown stalk angled left; same mature species and palette.

shape: A compact mature unit of TurkeyTail Trametes versicolor made of TWO overlapping thin semicircular FAN-SHAPED woody brackets with scalloped cream-white edges and three or four broad concentric zones of muted blue-gray, gray-brown and cream. Very short side attachments, NO long central stems, NO radial gills, NO log or bark prop. Differentiate concentric cap color bands clearly at small game size.
variation: THREE compact mature overlapping fan brackets in a different asymmetrical arrangement, pale scalloped outer edges, the SAME broad muted blue-gray/brown/cream concentric color zones; no tall stems.

shape: A tiny mature unit of Mycena chlorophos: exactly TWO delicate shallow pleated umbrella caps on very slender curved pale mint-gray stalks, each cap has a small flat/depressed center and six to eight simplified broad radial pleat marks. Use cool pale mint-green cap planes with a slightly darker green central dimple, inspired by the real GREEN BIOLUMINESCENCE photographs. NOT chunky green button mushrooms, not broad shelf fans. No bloom/glow halo outside the silhouette; the green is represented through flat drawn color only, while alpha background stays clear.
variation: Exactly THREE delicate small shallow umbrella caps in a different mature arrangement, one taller and leaning slightly right, very slender curved mint-gray stalks, radial cap pleats and the SAME mint-green palette; not early growth.
